title: CommonGround Golf Course
specs: Men must wear collared golf shirt; women must wear golf attire; no t-shirts, tank tops, cut off shorts, jeans, beach wear, or gym wear
Handicap flags require valid handicap sticker or doctor's note

Minimum 120 players required for shotgun start in tournaments
Tournament coordination and amenities available for groups and corporate events
includes: Golf cart rental included in cart fees
Golf shop credit prizes for leagues
gap: Age minimum for playing golf not stated
blurb: CommonGround Golf Course is a Tom Doak designed golf course located near Denver, Colorado. Guests can play rounds of golf, participate in various leagues, or host tournaments and group events. The facility offers golf carts, practice facilities, and a pro shop with merchandise and services.
extraNote: Tee times may be booked online 7 days in advance for members, 6 days for non-members; advanced booking up to 90 days with $20 fee · Cancellations require 24 hours notice; no-shows incur $20 fee · No outside food or beverage allowed; all refreshments must be purchased on site · No metal spikes allowed; spike-less golf facility · Golfers play at their own risk in inclement weather; rainchecks issued at staff discretion
